h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pali

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pali

c: Pali in Rajasthan's Marwar region is a textile dyeing and printing town, and its units and worker colonies sit on dry, sandy ground under a hard sun. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Pali for textile units, schools, colleges, residential colonies and the municipal council's parks. We build every machine at our Vasai factory, about 710 km away, and send it by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in western India fixes the machines on site. Pali's summers are long and very hot, with dust storms before a short monsoon, and winter nights are cool. Heat and sand shape our advice. We suggest shade from trees or a pergola, a concrete base that stops sand building up around footings, and a weekly wipe of the moving parts.

items.q: How do we keep sand out of outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Set them on a raised concrete base, sweep it often and wipe the moving joints every week. After a dust storm, clean the machines before anyone uses them.

items.q: Can a textile unit in Pali set up a gym for its workers?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the space, the number of workers per shift and where the sheds are. We will suggest a set and place it on the layout away from dust and fumes.

items.q: What warranty do you offer in Rajasthan?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as instructed.
